required.name: Certificate III in Heavy Vehicle/Diesel Fitting (or equivalent)
required.hint: Certificate III Heavy Commercial Vehicle, Mobile Plant Technology, Diesel Fitting, or equivalent

required.name: Minimum 2 years post-trade experience with HME/heavy mobile plant
required.hint: experience with heavy mobile equipment, mining, ports, or resources

required.name: Working at Heights, Confined Space & Gas Test Atmospheres (current ≤ 2 years)
required.hint: WAH/Confined Space/GTA tickets current/valid within 2 years

required.name: Strong safety mindset, teamwork, clear communication
required.hint: safety focus, team player, good communication under shutdown/project conditions

positives.name: Field-based diesel fitting experience
positives.hint: field service, breakdowns, servicing mobile equipment on site

positives.name: Maintenance on stacker-reclaimer components, haul trucks, or auxiliary plant
positives.hint: stacker-reclaimer mobile components, haul trucks, auxiliary plant

positives.name: History with shutdown contractors (e.g., Sync Lift, Monadelphous, UGL, Downer)
Flexibility for ROTB/FIFO schedules
positives.hint: willing to work fly-in fly-out or rostered on-the-bus

red_flags.name: No recognised diesel/mobile plant trade qualification
red_flags.hint: no Certificate III or equivalent trade qualification

red_flags.name: No evidence of diesel fitting experience
red_flags.hint: no experience in diesel fitting, heavy equipment, or mining

red_flags.name: Missing mandatory safety certifications
red_flags.hint: no White Card, Heights, Confined Space, Gas Test

red_flags.name: Unwilling/unable to complete medical or drug/alcohol screening
red_flags.hint: refused/failed pre-employment medical or D&A test

red_flags.name: Limited mobility/availability for regional QLD work
red_flags.hint: cannot travel, not flexible for regional projects
